ideas.pitch: An offline-first, mobile-friendly Python application combining computer vision and regression models to detect early-stage crop stress and forecast yields for smallholder Indian farmers.
ideas.title: AgriYield AI: Localized Crop Disease & Yield Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an urgent, highly visible socio-economic issue in India with a clear measurable impact on agriculture, aligning with the Green Planet track evaluated by JNTUH judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized speech-to-text and NLP triage platform designed for rural clinics, translating symptoms in regional Indian languages into structured pre-diagnosis reports for doctors.
ideas.title: RuralMed: Multilingual AI Triage and Health Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds upon proven multilingual health awareness frameworks while targeting an immediate healthcare accessibility gap recognized by academic and regional judges.

ideas.pitch: A data ingestion pipeline and analytics dashboard that parses utility bills, transport logs, and waste reports to calculate and forecast institutional carbon emissions.
ideas.title: CampusCarbon: Automated Carbon Footprint Tracker for Universities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real organizational problem that the JNTUH evaluating panel and university administrators experience firsthand regarding campus sustainability metrics.

ideas.pitch: A specialized GenAI agent that analyzes student Python repositories for code smells, security anti-patterns, and optimization bottlenecks, providing actionable inline feedback.
ideas.title: CodeMentor AI: Autonomous Code Reviewer for Student Submissions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets student and academic pain points with a working AI agent demo that professors and engineering evaluators will instantly appreciate during judging.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight computer vision system using pose estimation to translate basic sign language gestures into regional Indian text and speech for classroom inclusion.
ideas.title: SignBridge: Real-Time Sign Language to Regional Text Translator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a live, working computer vision demo with profound societal impact under the Human Impact track, scoring high on empathy and technical execution.
